newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures briefly visit lows after data.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures briefly visit lows after data.

text.p: June 4 - U.S. debt futures briefly brushed fresh lows after April US factory orders rose 1.2 pct vs forecasts for up 0.8 pct. March's drop revsd slightly upward. Some said Sept T-bonds expected to respect support at 109-22/32 - 23/32, near the 200-day moving average. Global, corporate supplies seen adding some weight.
